signature.name: VTask.dcomp
signature.type: {α : Sort u₁} -> {β : α → Sort u₂} -> {φ : {x : α} → β x → Sort u₃} -> (f : {x : α} → (y : β x) → φ y) -> (g : (x : α) → β x) -> (x : α) -> φ (g x)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.dcomp is a total, universe-polymorphic function composition operator with no junk-value or boundary conventions; it is defined for all inputs without restriction.
